question: Why should we hire you?
description: Sales pitch question assessing value proposition.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates candidate's understanding of role needs and self-confidence.
exampleAnswer: You should hire me because I bring both technical expertise and a track record of delivering results. In my current role, I reduced application load time by 45% and increased test coverage from 15% to 65%. I understand your tech stack and can contribute immediately. Additionally, I am a collaborative team player who communicates well with stakeholders, which aligns with your cross-functional culture.
evaluationCriteria: Specific evidence, role alignment, confidence, professionalism
followUpQuestions: What makes you different from other candidates?
How would you measure success in this role?
What is your most relevant achievement for this position?
